methodology.timing: Fresh child per variant/workload/size/round. No explicit GC or memory observer. Churn sample contains batch attempted actions including rollback; final hash/dispose outside timing. Replay sample includes import/preflight/create/run/per-root hashes/final hash/dispose; source recording built outside timing.
methodology.reference: Benchmark-only eager structuredClone/freeze state reference; replay supports only valid flat one-action logs and verifies every endpoint hash. It omits general runtime guards, nested FIFO, input/effect/routing/reactivity features. Same fixture effects/versions/alias graph and endpoint hashes; not a frontend-framework comparison.
methodology.memory: Separate fresh --expose-gc process for round 0, samples include harness/observer/JIT overhead. Natural GC events restricted to work interval; forced collections separately labeled. Heap high water is sampled, not allocated bytes/true peak; post-disposal deltas are trends, not leak proof.
methodology.ordering: Rotate variant order each round; cases run sequentially; do not run other test/benchmark jobs concurrently.
